chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey Ch.537 – The Void Heaven Cauldron Secret Spreads
chapter_meta_description: Patriarch Extreme Yin finally reveals the Void Heaven Cauldron secret. A false Bug Demon massacres low-level cultivators. Han Li returns to his island to begin alchemy breakthrough.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey – Ch.537: The Void Heaven Cauldron Leaks
og_description: Old foxes bargain over a cosmic treasure. A fake Bug Demon sows chaos abroad. Han Li settles in for a quiet alchemy session.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch.537: Extreme Yin Spills the Beans
twitter_description: The secret of the Void Heaven Cauldron is out. Can Han Li brew his way to safety?

lore_anchors.definition: A self-directed vow invoking one's inner demon as enforcer; in *A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality*, cultivators frequently break such oaths when profit outweighs fear.
A title for a cultivator commanding a massive insect swarm; in the Chaotic Star Sea, impersonators adopt this moniker to commit robbery and sow confusion.
The central treasure of the Void Heaven Palace, sealed in its innermost chamber; a supreme artifact that Nascent Soul cultivators across the sea are desperate to obtain.
A plateau in pill-refining skill where theoretical knowledge has peaked but practical experience and a flash of insight are needed to reach a new realm.
